title: [UPDATE] on Monthly Dana January 2026 1
description:
Migration Fix Summary - Phase 6A.74 Part 14

Problem: The newsletters page was returning 500 errors because the is_announcement_only column didn't exist in the database. The migration file was created but was missing the .Designer.cs file, which is required for EF Core to recognize and apply migrations.

Solution Applied:

  1. Deleted the incomplete migration file

  2. Regenerated the migration using dotnet ef migrations add which creates both the .cs and .Designer.cs files

  3. Committed and pushed to trigger CI/CD deployment

  4. Migration was automatically applied during deployment

Please consult systeme-architect do a comprehensive, systematic and Deep root cause analysis. Before you make any code changes, show me the RCA and the fix plan you create with system-architect.

---------------------------------------------

Please check whether this is an UI issue, Auth Issue, Backend API issue,  a Database issue or a feature missing case.

----------------------------------------------

Think as a Senior Software Engineer. Handle issues systematically, avoid shortcuts, and apply durable fixes rather than quick patches. And follow these best practices:


1. Follow established UI/UX best practices at all times — clarity and usability matter.


2. Use an incremental TDD process: write tests first, keep a zero-tolerance policy for compilation errors, and iterate in small, testable steps.


3. Consult the architect whenever you’re unsure about design, scope, or system-level impact.


4. Before making code changes, search the codebase for similar implementations and prefer reusable components over duplication.


5. Ensure that no existing functionality is broken when updating or implementing new code. This is especially important on the UI side, where components can be very fragile—so please make changes carefully and thoughtfully.


6. With the code implementation make sure to add enough logs and try catches for the observerbility and tracability


7. Make sure to commit your changes and update the status in both C:\Work\LankaConnect\docs\STREAMLINED_ACTION_PLAN.md and C:\Work\LankaConnect\docs\PROGRESS_TRACKER.md, following C:\Work\LankaConnect\docs\TASK_SYNCHRONIZATION_STRATEGY.md.


8. Use EF Core migrations for all database schema changes and data feeds. If migration issues occur, fix them before running migrations.


9. We have the dababase, backend and the frontend deployed in Azure staging.

   - All the backend changes must push and deployed to azure staging using deploy-staging.yml.

   - All the frontend changes must push and deployed to azure staging using deploy-ui-staging.yml.

title: 2026 projects
description:
As we begin the year 2026, we are excited to announce several initiatives we would like to accomplish in early  2026 as related  to our temple   property which will involve some fundraising and assistance from our community and friends .

 

First and foremost we would like to pay off the mortgage balance and convert the  property to a commercial non profit institute.  Presently we are considered a residential property and subject to property taxes. a Due to this fact we are having a very difficult time  obtaining  insurance as a private residence.  We will be sending an email with more information as to how you can help us with this endeavor.

 

Secondly, we would like to carry out some modifications to the large garage to convert it to a meditation hall.  Phase one of this project would involve demolishing metal beams  on the rear of the building, painting the metal ceiling and walls,  constructing an altar and installing flooring on 3/4 of the hall.  We would like to complete this renovation before April, as we have a very special two day program with Venerable Kothmale Kumara Kassapa Thero on April 4 and 5..   The renovation process will need your help for labor and monetary assistance. An email will be forthcoming soon with details.

 

We would also like to install a shower stall for the bhante's bathroom. The current tub is in very poor condition and must be demolished.  We have some volunteers who have  agreed to purchase the material for this project.  We will need some help with labor. We will send an email with more detail on this project and how you can volunteer for labor.

 

These are ambitious projects and must be accomplished to  ensure the long term sustainability  of our temple.  We hope  for everyone's assistance and contributions  to make this happen.

 

We thank you for  all your support in the past and your continued support as we move forward.
